items.text: Round 3 answers incorporated into conclusion.md. d1=C: Actions now produce two documents — an authoritative internal spec at `docs/internal/desktop-runtime-discovery-contract.md` plus a short deployment-focused explainer at `docs/deployment/desktop-runtime-discovery.md` that links to the internal spec as the normative source. The deployment explainer intentionally does not restate the contract body to minimize drift.

d2=A applied: the Regression Matrix is now split into mandatory cases (1–9) and nice-to-have / future hardening (10). Case 10 (concurrent-start race) is explicitly non-blocking for initial contract proof and is called out in both the matrix and the Limitations section. Cases 1–7 are core semantics; 8–9 are Windows parity; all nine are launch-gating.

d3=A applied: the contract now explicitly documents that an empty `source` on a legacy record is treated as `"swarm"` for precedence purposes. This is stated in Finding 5, in the 'Default precedence' and 'Schema change' subsections of Contract Summary (Final Form), and in Finding 6 (precedence patch). No swarm-lifecycle backfill is required — empty `source` remains valid forever and precedence is a pure `bundle > swarm|empty` comparison.

Readiness re-scored against the finalized conclusion: all five dimensions at 3. Previously testable was at 2 pending the regression-matrix scoping decision (d2); with d2=A now reflected in the matrix, testable moves to 3. No remaining gaps block the downstream execute items. Both `execute/cross-platform-bundled-discovery-parity` and `execute/desktop-ecosystem-interop-regression-coverage` can proceed using the conclusion as-is.

Residual risks (enumerated in Limitations): tiebreaker for multiple bundle records, PID-reuse hardening, multi-install-of-same-app, XDG migration, no network layer, concurrent-start race, and dual-publication drift. All are bounded, explicitly out-of-scope for this contract, and have named follow-up paths. None are latent unknowns.

plan_updates: Finalized conclusion.md by incorporating the three round-3 answers. Actions restructured from a single deployment-doc target into Action 1 (internal spec at docs/internal/desktop-runtime-discovery-contract.md, normative), Action 2 (deployment explainer at docs/deployment/desktop-runtime-discovery.md, links to internal spec), Action 3 (architecture-docs index pointer), plus Actions 4–6 (hand-offs). Regression Matrix now has a Class column splitting mandatory (1–9) from nice-to-have (10), with a scope-rule paragraph above the table. 'Default precedence', 'Schema change', Finding 5, and Finding 6 now explicitly state that empty `source` is treated as `swarm`. Added a dual-publication drift note and a concurrent-start deferral note to Limitations. Readiness is 3/3/3/3/3.
